summary: Tested the FCM tap-to-open deep-link flow end-to-end. Backend: GET /api/payments/{id} returns enriched doc (200) and 404 for unknown; /payments/pending-count and /payments/pending-ids are not shadowed by the {payment_id} route (route order correct). Frontend deep-link flow works perfectly: /{slug}/admin/payments?open=payment:<approved-id> opens payment-detail-page-{id} and strips ?open from URL; pending kiosk payment opens approve-modal immediately; window.onFcmOpen('/admin/payments?open=…') navigates in-app and opens detail; postMessage FCM_OPEN works; unsafe URLs (https://evil.com, //evil, javascript:alert) are ignored. HOWEVER: when the kiosk employee flow creates a pending payment, the SSE notification data.url is '/admin/payments?filter=pending' instead of the expected '/admin/payments?open=payment:<id>'. Root cause: kiosk_create_payment sets kind='payment_pending_approval' which is NOT in _deep_link's whitelist ('payment','payment_pending','approval'), so _deep_link falls back to the pre-set url. For users who get the FCM push and tap it, the APK will land on the pending-filter view instead of directly opening the approve modal.

critical.issue: Pending kiosk payment notification carries data.url='/admin/payments?filter=pending' instead of '/admin/payments?open=payment:<id>'. _deep_link whitelist ('payment','payment_pending','approval') does not include the kind sent by kiosk_create_payment ('payment_pending_approval'). Review request explicitly says this should deep-link to the specific payment. Fix: either rename kind to 'payment_pending'/'approval' on line 10671, OR add 'payment_pending_approval' to the whitelist in _deep_link (server.py:15162).

minor.issue: GZipMiddleware wraps the SSE stream (content-encoding: gzip, Transfer-Encoding: chunked) because event payloads do not have Content-Length. GZip buffering can delay/break event flushing for some clients. SSE should bypass gzip. Fix: either exclude text/event-stream from GZipMiddleware or raise minimum_size inspection to skip streaming responses. Observed on localhost:8001; EventSource in Chrome still works but curl/requests experienced buffering until identity encoding was forced.

action_items: BACKEND HIGH: In server.py:10671 the kiosk pending-payment notification uses kind='payment_pending_approval'; _deep_link doesn't recognize it so the URL stays '/admin/payments?filter=pending'. Either (a) change kind to 'payment_pending' (preferred — matches tenant-portal flow), or (b) add 'payment_pending_approval' to the whitelist at server.py:15162. After fix, the pytest `test_kiosk_pending_payment_notification_has_deep_link` should assert /admin/payments?open=payment:<id>.
BACKEND MINOR: Exclude SSE (text/event-stream) from GZipMiddleware so clients get immediate flushing.
critical_code_review_comments: deep-link.js: `p.delete('open'); p.delete('tenant');` — tenant is removed unconditionally for every deep-linked tab even when the tab didn't use ?tenant. Minor but acceptable. If other query params ever use 'tenant', they'd be stripped silently.

fcm-apk.js openFromNotification: good safety on '/' and '//'. But accepts anything starting with '/' including '/login' or '/kiosk' which would log the admin out of the admin shell. Consider restricting to '/admin/' + known tab-paths or a /{slug}/admin/* allow-list.

deep_link whitelist is tightly coupled to a fixed set of kinds. Any new notification kind requires adding a case — easy to miss (as happened for kiosk flow). Consider making deep_link dispatch on explicit `payment_id`/`plan_id`/… presence rather than kind.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all deep-link + onFcmOpen + postMessage + unsafe-URL + URL-cleanup scenarios pass)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL buffers SSE at Cloudflare; for SSE tests always hit http://localhost:8001/api/admin/events with Accept-Encoding: identity (iter94 test uses this). Backend auto-reset of demo DB wipes Anita's kiosk_pin + app_role every ~30 min — the test fixture restores both via PUT /api/employees/{id} (don't set email because another account already uses anita@demo.sr). Demo admin after login is slug-prefixed: /my-awesome-rentals-bv/admin/<tab>; waiting ~3s after login lets the redirect settle. Direct navigation to /admin/payments without the slug lands you on the dashboard — always derive slug from page.url first. useDeepLink hook strips ?open and ?tenant from URL after firing — test expects both gone.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: 1) login admin + open SSE /api/admin/events, 2) login kiosk with Anita PIN 4321, 3) POST /api/kiosk/payments?employee_id=<anita>&employee_pin=4321 with a small amount, 4) observe SSE 'notification' event. Expected data.url='/admin/payments?open=payment:<new id>'. Actual: '/admin/payments?filter=pending'. Flow: kiosk_create_payment (server.py:10617) passes {'kind':'payment_pending_approval','url':'/admin/payments?filter=pending',...} to _notify_company_admins. _notify_company_admins overwrites data['url'] via _deep_link. _deep_link checks `kind in ('payment','payment_pending','approval')` — 'payment_pending_approval' doesn't match, so it falls through to `d.get('url') or '/admin'`, keeping the pending-filter URL. Mitigation: change kind to 'payment_pending' OR extend _deep_link whitelist. Tenant-portal payment (server.py:6869) already uses 'payment_pending' correctly.
